name: Browser
description: A real Chromium browser inside TEDI, driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Reuses the Chrome, Edge, Brave or Chromium already on the machine and only downloads Chrome for Testing when none is found, so the TEDI installer stays unchanged. Renders into a pane over a CDP screencast, keeps its own profile so Chrome Web Store extensions persist, and gives the AI agent an accessibility-tree view of the page instead of a scraped one. Every browser action is also an MCP tool, so an outside CLI drives the same tabs you do.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com

settings.label: Screencast quality
settings.description: 1-100. Lower is sharper on bandwidth and CPU, higher is sharper on text. 70 reads well and stays cheap.

settings.label: Stop Chromium after idle minutes
settings.description: Close the Chromium process when no browser pane has been open this long, so a background browser stops costing RAM. 0 keeps it running.
